package.name: ur3e_realsense_handeye
package.description: Eye-to-hand calibration suite for a UR3e + Intel RealSense D435i (or any UR-arm + monocular camera). Detects a ChArUco board on the EE, captures (board-in-camera, tool0-in-base) pairs, and solves for the fixed camera-in-base transform using OpenCV's hand-eye solvers (Tsai/Park/Horaud/Andreff/Daniilidis), the robot-world hand-eye solvers (Shah/Li), and a non-linear refinement.
